project.title: Heritage Short: The Patience of Buna
project.style_block: Cinematic documentary aesthetic, warm golden hour and charcoal ember glow, cool overcast rain exterior contrast, 35mm anamorphic film look, rich organic earthy tones, soft volumetric smoke diffusion, photorealistic textures, centered subject composition, no text overlays, no watermarks.
project.character_bible: Mother (Emaye): Dignified Ethiopian woman in her late 40s, warm weathered eyes, serene maternal expression, adorned in a pristine white cotton Habesha Kemis with traditional green woven embroidery (Tilet) along the neckline, seated gracefully beside a clay charcoal stove.

music.caption: Acoustic Ethiopian meditative melody featuring delicate Masenqo and Krar motifs, subtle rain ambient Foley, warm cello swells, slow contemplative pacing.

project.end_card_text: Created with AI-assisted generative tools (Gemini Speech, FLUX.1 schnell, Wan 2.2) honoring Ethiopian oral heritage and family cultural memory.

shots.reason: Establishes the contemplative mood and rainy Addis Ababa Kiremt setting outside the family home.
shots.narration_text: በአዲስ አበባ የክረምት ዝናብ በቆርቆሮው ጣሪያ ላይ ያለማቋረጥ ሲዘንብ፣ ቤታችን በልዩ ሙቀት ይሞላል።
shots.subtitle_en: When Kiremt rain drums endlessly on the tin roof, our home fills with warmth.
shots.image_prompt: Centered view of an Addis Ababa neighborhood during heavy rainy season, green eucalyptus hills in distance, rain dripping from corrugated iron roof eaves, warm amber interior light glowing from a doorway in the center, misty atmosphere.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle tilt down from wet tin roof eaves to the warm glowing doorway, raindrops falling smoothly.

shots.reason: Introduces the mother preparing the ceremonial space with traditional green grass and clay stove.
shots.narration_text: እማዬ ሁልጊዜ ከሰዓት በኋላ ለምለም የቄጠማ ሣር ወለሉ ላይ ጎዝጉዛ፣ በትንሹ የሸክላ ምድጃ ከሰል ታቀጣጥላለች።
shots.subtitle_en: Mother spreads fresh green grass and lights charcoal in the clay stove.
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium shot of an Ethiopian mother in white Habesha Kemis arranging fresh green ketema grass across a clean wooden floor, beside a traditional clay stove with red embers glowing warmly in the center.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle slow camera push-in toward the mother's gentle hands arranging the grass, embers pulsing with soft light.

shots.reason: Focuses on raw green coffee beans entering the black iron pan, initiating the transformation ritual.
shots.narration_text: ጥሬ አረንጓዴ የቡና ፍሬዎች በጠቆረው የብረት ምጣድ ላይ ሲቀመጡ፣ የዕለቱ የቡና ሥነ-ሥርዓት በይፋ ይጀምራል።
shots.subtitle_en: Raw green coffee beans placed on the black iron pan begin the sacred ceremony.
shots.image_prompt: Centered overhead insert shot of fresh pale-green unroasted coffee beans resting in a circular black cast-iron pan set over glowing orange embers in a clay stove.
shots.motion_prompt: Steady macro view, gentle heat shimmers rising from the hot embers beneath the pan.

shots.reason: Captures the child's youthful impatience and longing for the roasted aroma and first brew.
shots.narration_text: እኔ በህፃንነቴ ትዕግሥት በማጣት 'እማዬ ፍጠኚ፣ ቶሎ አፍዪልኝ' እያልኩ ቡናው እስኪደርስ እጨቀጭቃት ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: As an impatient child, I would beg her: 'Hurry Mama, brew it quickly!'
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium close-up of a young Ethiopian child leaning eagerly against a wooden stool, looking toward mother with wide curious eyes, backlit by warm ember light and cool rainy window.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle handheld breathing camera motion, child gently shifting weight in eager anticipation.

shots.reason: Demonstrates maternal tranquility and sensory grace as aromatic coffee smoke begins to swirl.
shots.narration_text: እሷ ግን በፈገግታ እያየችኝ፣ የብረት ማንኪያውን በምጣዱ ላይ እያዟዟረች፣ የቡናው መዓዛ ክፍል ውስጥ እንዲናኝ ታደርጋለች።
shots.subtitle_en: She would only smile, stirring the pan as fragrant white smoke filled the room.
shots.image_prompt: Centered close-up of an Ethiopian mother smiling warmly with serene maternal grace, stirring roasting coffee beans with a traditional metal hook spoon, soft white aromatic smoke swirling around her.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle slow-motion stir of the spoon among the beans, fragrant smoke curling lazily upward.

shots.reason: Highlights the acoustic crackle and color transition of the beans as emotional calming agent.
shots.narration_text: ፍሬዎቹ ከቢጫ ወደ ጥቁር ቡናማ ሲቀየሩና ሲፈነዱ የሚሰማው ድምፅ፣ የልቤን የናፍቆት ምት ያረጋጋው ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: As beans turned golden brown and popped, their crackle calmed my restless heart.
shots.image_prompt: Centered insert macro shot of glossy roasting coffee beans sizzling and popping in the hot iron pan, changing color to deep roasted chocolate brown, wisps of fragrant smoke rising.
shots.motion_prompt: Extremely slow pan across the crackling beans, soft smoke wisps drifting past the lens.

shots.reason: The philosophical apex of the film: mother delivers the proverb teaching life-long patience.
shots.narration_text: እማዬም ቀስ ብላ 'ልጄ ሆይ፣ ቀስ በቀስ እንቁላል በእግሩ ይሄዳል፤ መቻኮል ቡናንም ሆነ ሕይወትን ያበላሻል' ትለኛለች።
shots.subtitle_en: She said: 'Slowly, an egg learns to walk; rushing ruins both coffee and life.'
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium close-up of the mother speaking tenderly, soft firelight illuminating her expressive face and traditional Habesha Kemis, rain streaking down the windowpane behind her.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow, steady cinematic push-in on the mother's eyes and calm reassuring expression.

shots.reason: The ritual payoff: pouring the finished first brew into the delicate cini cup.
shots.narration_text: ከጥቁሩ ጀበና የሚፈሰው የመጀመሪያው የአቦል ቡና ሲኒውን ሲሞላ፣ የትዕግሥት ውጤት ምን ያህል ጣፋጭ እንደሆነ ገባኝ።
shots.subtitle_en: As abol poured from the clay jebena, I tasted the sweetness of patience.
shots.image_prompt: Centered close-up of dark steaming Ethiopian coffee pouring in a continuous graceful arc from a black clay jebena spout into small porcelain cini cups resting on a low wooden mesob.
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth steady tracking shot following the dark stream of coffee pouring into the steaming cup.

shots.reason: Resolution and adult reflection: the sensory memory and maternal lesson remain a lifelong anchor.
shots.narration_text: ዛሬም በሩጫ የተሞላው ዓለም ሲያስጨንቀኝ፣ የእማዬን ድምፅና ያንን ፀጥተኛ የቡና ጠረን አስታውሳለሁ።
shots.subtitle_en: Years later in a rushed world, I still hear her voice and remember not to hurry.
shots.image_prompt: Centered wide shot of an adult sitting peacefully by a rain-streaked window holding a steaming cup of coffee, warm interior lighting reflecting memories of mother, tranquil atmosphere.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow cinematic pull-back revealing the serene rain on the window and the steaming coffee cup.
